title: Rima vs. Claude for Tax Resolution: Choosing the Right Tool
summary: Compare a general-purpose AI assistant with Rima’s tax resolution preparation and IRM research workflows, with human review in both cases.
body_markdown:
Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant that can help draft text, analyze material, and reason through questions. Its features change over time and vary by plan and configuration. Rima is focused on tax resolution case preparation. The useful comparison is what each workflow asks a practitioner to do before relying on its output.


## For an open-ended question


A general-purpose assistant can be useful for brainstorming, summarizing a non-confidential topic, or drafting a checklist. For client-specific work, verify any cited authority against its source and follow your firm’s policies for handling client data. Do not assume an AI answer determines a taxpayer’s eligibility or the right resolution strategy.


## For collection-form preparation


Rima’s[document automation](https://www.getrima.ai/product/document-automation) reads financial source documents, maps relevant values into 433-F, 433-B, and 433-A (OIC) templates, and flags gaps for review. A practitioner checks the source, resolves unclear entries, and approves the draft. The[433-F case study](https://www.getrima.ai/resources/case-study/433-f-prep) describes one firm moving from about 90 minutes to 30 minutes for preparation; that is not a promise for other cases.


For a closer look at the inputs and review checkpoints, see the[433-F preparation guide](https://www.getrima.ai/resources/433-f-preparation-guide) .


## For research and advocacy


Rima[Advisor](https://www.getrima.ai/product/advisor) supports resolution evaluation and proposed advocacy angles with relevant IRM sections. An enrolled agent should read the cited guidance and assess how it applies to the client’s facts before using it. A general assistant can also help explore a question, but neither tool replaces authoritative source review.


## How to choose


- Define whether you need open-ended writing help, structured case preparation, or both.
- Check current product capabilities directly; do not base a decision on fixed upload-limit or integration comparisons.
- Test a representative case and inspect how easily a reviewer can validate sources and correct mistakes.
- Keep the final tax resolution decision and filing review with a qualified professional.


Read more about[AI agents in tax resolution](https://www.getrima.ai/blog/ai-agents-for-tax-resolution) and[spreadsheet workpapers](https://www.getrima.ai/blog/tax-resolution-financial-workpapers) .
